propositions: Over-triggering of full re-reviews on byte-identical material due to undeclared file_impact causing any code-SHA change to invalidate attestations must be scoped to the review read-set and blast-radius paths instead of invalidating on ALL code-SHA drift.

The signed manifest must record normalized read paths from observed fetch telemetry, filtered to read_file tool only, resolved to repo-relative POSIX form, and deduplicated, with a read-set marker indicating recording occurred.

When the pre-existing dependency set is empty, container poison rule is inactive, scope is undeclared, and a read-set was recorded, the ADR-0002 dependency check must compose read-set entries with blast-radius globs (criteria routing, rebar.toml, criteria definitions, reviewer markdown, workflow gates) using membership digest for glob changes and per-file hashing for individual paths.
Unverifiable read-set, pre-change attestations lacking the read-set field, and expansion failures must fall back to invalidate-on-any-change (whole-HEAD).
The plan-review status command must report the currency basis (file_impact, read-set, or fail-safe) in both text and JSON output.
Already-scoped sets, poisoned containers, and declared-none scopes must remain exempt from read-set based drift invalidation.
